Funding Opportunities
Funding Opportunities
Funding and Employment Opportunities
In addition to financial aid in the form of grants, loans, work-study and scholarships, prospective and current graduate students may be eligible to apply for various graduate employment opportunities on campus. Examples of positions include Gradaute Assistant, Graduate Coordinator, Resident Director, Research Fellow, or Teaching Fellow. These positions are funded and hired by the academic and administrative units, therefore compensation packages vary based on the nature of the job responsibilities and available funds. Rowan University adheres to the Council on Graduate School’s "April 15th Resolution".
All graduate student employees and hiring supervisors are expected to be familiar with the Graduate Student Employee Handbook.
Available graduate employment opportunities on Rowan campuses can be found in one place. External funding opportunities such as scholarships, travel grants, and other awards can be found on the menu to the left.
If you are a Rowan graduate student experiencing an unexpected financial hardship, please view the university's Student Emergency Assistance website here.
Available Graduate Employment Opportunities
Graduate employment opportunities are funded and hired by individual academic units, programs, or research grants. Open job opportunities can be found here.
Graduate Student Travel Fund
The School of Graduate Studies provides conference travel fund assistance to graduate students throughout the year.
External Funding Opportunities
A variety of external funding opportunities are available including scholarships, grants to conduct dissertation research, and travel awards.
